enunciado: Sort the scores {4, 2, 7, 2, 9, 4, 0, 7, 7, 1} (values 0 to 9) without comparing elements: count how many times each value appears and rebuild the array.
objetivos: Sort without comparisons when the range is small
pistas: You need one counter per possible value (10).
Go through values 0 to 9 and write each one as many times as it appeared.
The cost is O(n + k), where k is the size of the range.
